change: FITS writer records a versioned HYBRID_CTX extension with source-save acquisition context and explicitly selected rendering parameters. Primary pixels and other extensions are preserved; no credential-bearing configuration sections are copied.
scope: Camera/profile identity, exposure timestamp and UTC offset, gain/binning, day/night/moon mode, calibration phase and rendering parameter snapshot.
Metadata serialization failure logs the error and preserves the scientific exposure without the optional context.
Context reader rejects unsupported versions, duplicate extensions, invalid JSON/nonfinite values and oversized or malformed context arrays.
complete_render_recipe remains false: later stack/AWB/detection/label context is not captured by this source-save snapshot.

assertions: Mono/RGB integer and floating pixel values preserved; other HDUs and live source HDU list unchanged.
Plain and gzip writer integration, stored file size and database dimensions preserved.
Camera/profile/time isolation, explicit UTC offset, credential exclusion and immutable configuration snapshot.
Injected serialization failure still saves original source pixels.

deployment: Not deployed. Production remains 0cf2de6e/application 994ac136. No capture restart, format-policy change or media deletion.
remaining: Full replay context and source-backed consumers/cache/settings are still required for FITS-night/JPEG-day archival.
